answers.core: It adds another compiled option to Godot which makes Godot compile as a library
answers.workaround: It might not be used that often if people have to compile themselves but if the LibGodotSharp binding was set up on NuGet I can see a lot of C# developers of software using Godot as a UI library

title: Add a build-time option to compile Godot as a shared library (for use in other languages)
